goal: Classify legacy Browse rows through a versioned progression authority, separate crafted-stat selections, and rerun the bounded Phase 0 audit without changing runtime data, schemas, APIs, releases or pointers.
userValue: A player can eventually choose a current-season equipment variant whose regular upgrade rank, crafted quality, Ascendant state and static attributes come from one explicit authority instead of guessed or overloaded legacy fields.
nonGoals: Do not start Catalog migration Phase 1 or activate a new CatalogRevision.

Do not change PostgreSQL schema, Gear Release rows, Community Release rows, active Manifest pointers, public APIs, Taro pages, Resolver behavior, serializers, timers, services or SimulationCraft runtime.
Do not manufacture rank from generic payload fields, display text, tooltip text or bonus IDs.
Do not clear independent Phase 0 blockers such as missing Community Release evidence, 40-specialization candidate blockage, partial resource peaks or unresolved callers.

mustChange: Add one pure, versioned Track Authority bound to the active season and gear-rule revision.
Resolve regular upgrade tracks, crafted quality and Ascendant states into a discriminated progression contract without reading generic rank.
Project only the bounded source evidence needed by the authority through the existing read-only PostgreSQL audit store.
Collapse repeated crafted-stat legacy rows into one canonical BrowseVariant plus explicit EnhancementSelection associations.
Rerun the aggregate production audit with zero writes, stable active pointers and content-addressed evidence.
mustNotChange: PostgreSQL schema and all persisted Gear, Community, Manifest and Catalog release rows remain unchanged.
Public API, Taro, Resolver, serializer, timer, service, deployment and SimulationCraft runtime behavior remain unchanged.
The original Phase 0 release packet remains immutable historical evidence for PR #101.
Phase 1 remains blocked unless every independent gate passes in one fresh mechanical decision.
riskUnknown: Some ordinary Ascendant rows may lack sufficient governed source or observed exact-instance evidence and must remain blocked.
The known 48 missing-static-stat rows must remain explicit even after progression classification succeeds.
PR #101 must land before this stacked branch can expose exactly one task-scoped release packet against main.
evidenceRequired: Failing and passing focused tests for authority binding, progression resolution, crafted collapse, read-only projection and CLI binding.
A fresh aggregate-only production audit using the exact committed tools in a disposable directory and transient collected unit.
Literal proof of zero PostgreSQL writes, stable active Manifest pointer, bounded query settings and complete cleanup.
A mechanical Phase 1 decision retaining every independent blocker and allowedNextPlan none.
A clean exact-head Harness check and task-only local code review.

The read-only production rerun records legacy/canonical/crafted counts, all remaining problems, zero writes and stable pointers.
